title: Austin Budget Proposal Revealed
summary:
*   The City Manager unveiled the proposed Operating Budget for the upcoming 1992-93 fiscal year.
*   This crucial financial plan, detailing the city's spending, was presented with the aid of slides.
*   Council members actively engaged with the proposal, posing questions about the budget outline.
